title: The Emu War: The Birds That Beat the Machine Guns
summary: Tells of the operation that soldiers under Major Meredith carried out with Lewis machine guns in the autumn of nineteen thirty-two against some twenty thousand emus that overran the wheat fields of Western Australia. The episode ranges from fields where First World War veteran farmers were struggling with drought and the Depression, to ambushes that yielded meagre results for thousands of rounds, to a withdrawal mocked in parliament, and to how the problem was finally solved not by bullets but by a bounty system.
